identity: The trade ring's public concourse: one wide hall with a docking bay off the east side. You enter from the west airlock, cross the hall past the central column, and pass through to the dock. A bench sits against the south wall.
units: absolute local units, 31 = player height, +y is south (screen-down). Lanes want >= 15 u clear.

placements.note: on the centre-line on purpose; hall is built around it
flush to the south wall, clear of every lane
